name: Explain Islamic theology, jurisprudence, and Quranic texts
description: Users requested detailed explanations, verses, and scholarly interpretations regarding Islamic theology, jurisprudence, and Quranic analysis, often seeking rigorous academic support or specific rulings. Some requests also involved answering multiple-choice questions on religious texts or seeking guidance on personal rituals and etiquette within the Islamic faith.
